summary: Admin login experience fully verified. Full PHPUnit suite: 122/122 passing (393 assertions) including the 9 new AdminLoginExperienceTest cases. Live preview E2E confirms: /login=200 with data-testid='login-admin-link' anchor pointing to /admin/login using outline style (.admin-link class, transparent bg + border) distinct from primary Sign in button (.primary, dark bg); POST /login as ambassador-only redirects to /ambassador/dashboard; GET /post-login unauthenticated redirects to /login; GET /post-login as ambassador-only redirects to /ambassador/dashboard; GET /admin as ambassador-only returns 403 (Filament policy); ambassador dashboard HTML contains 0 occurrences of 'Admin Access' / 'nav-admin-access' for ambassador-only user. All 9 unit test cases (dual-role chooser, admin-only redirect, super_admin redirect, dual-role dashboard shows Admin Access) pass in phpunit.

e2e_results.GET /login: 200, contains data-testid="login-admin-link" href="/admin/login" text 'Are you an administrator? Sign in here', outline style (.admin-link, transparent bg, 1px border) distinct from .primary CTA
e2e_results.GET /admin (ambassador-only auth): 403 (Filament canAccessPanel rejects — assertion allows 302->/admin/login OR 403; got 403)
e2e_results.GET /ambassador/dashboard (ambassador-on: 200, ZERO occurrences of 'Admin Access' or 'nav-admin-access' — correctly hidden

critical_code_review_comments: LoginController::store correctly ANDs hasPanel && hasAmbassador for dual-role chooser branch — matches spec.
PostLoginChooserController::show short-circuits single-role users home (301/302 to /admin or /ambassador/dashboard) — verified via feature test and live E2E as ambassador-only user.
Ambassador layout uses hasAnyRole(Role::panelRoles()) gate for the 'Admin Access' nav item — E2E confirms 0 leaks to ambassador-only accounts.
login.blade.php .admin-link uses transparent bg + 1px border (outline/ghost) — visually distinct from .primary (dark filled) — meets 'not primary CTA' requirement.
